in_sanskrit.name: Sharvikaanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Sharvi + Goddess Kanya
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvikaanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Combination of the names of the goddess Sharvi and Kanya. Sharvi is a goddess who is often depicted riding on a lion and is associated with power, victory and strength. Kanya, on the other hand, is the Sanskrit word for virgin and represents purity, grace and protection.
